# Review protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What recall findings are reported in the supplied invented learning-garden records?

## Scope and criteria
Include both supplied synthetic records and their associated claims and source passages. No date, language, population, or design restriction beyond membership in the supplied fixture applies. Exclude external records and any invented additions to source metadata or results. Treat the supplied passages as the complete available source texts, not as independently retrieved publications.

The user authorized a complete fixed-corpus capture. Preserve the supplied claim/source pairs and synthesis wording exactly. Scope and small-corpus checkpoints do not require a pause for this explicitly specified capture task.

## Reading and synthesis

The fulltext field denotes availability of the complete supplied synthetic passage only. Claims and synthesis are copied directly from the fixture to preserve their exact wording. refs.json preserves the supplied empty reference list. Corpus author and year metadata remain available in corpus.json and the notes.

## Retrieval summary
Both supplied synthetic source passages are available. No source passage is missing and no external PDF retrieval was attempted. There are no missing PDF drop-in requests. This summary is kept outside synthesis.md to preserve the supplied synthesis exactly.

## Capture boundary
